ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; the visible ventral surface is composed of approximately 99% low-intensity (black) pixels with negligible high-intensity (white) distribution.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by irregular pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave geometric trajectory fitted to the trailing edge, curving from the distal tips toward the central median notch.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniformly dark pigmentation (all-black type) across the entire visible ventral surface of the fluke.
